name: mrcd-tldraw-check
description: Renders a tldraw connector script in a local copy of tldraw, so a sketch can be checked before (or instead of) sending it to the shared canvas.

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/ && esbuild main.jsx --bundle --outdir=www --jsx=automatic --loader:.woff2=file --loader:.woff=file --loader:.png=file --loader:.svg=file --loader:.json=file --asset-names=[name] --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --minify --log-level=warning
